name: stat
title: Stat
description: Label, condensed tabular value and unit, with an inline figure slot for a sparkline.
docs: Values are preformatted strings, so locale and rounding stay with you. A null, undefined or empty value renders emptyText in the faint ink colour and hides the unit. tone colours the value: default ink, accent, or accent-alt which maps to the theme danger colour. Drop a Sparkline into the figure slot; it is baseline aligned with the value.

files.content:
<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, useAttrs } from 'vue'
import type { ClassValue } from 'clsx'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'
import {
  StatPart,
  StatLabelPart,
  StatValueRowPart,
  StatValuePart,
  StatUnitPart,
  StatFigurePart,
} from './parts'

defineOptions({ inheritAttrs: false })

export type StatTone = 'default' | 'accent' | 'accent-alt'

export type StatProps = {
  label: string
  /** Preformatted value. Null or undefined renders `emptyText`. */
  value?: string | number | null
  unit?: string
  emptyText?: string
  /** Colours the value; `accent-alt` uses the theme danger colour. */
  tone?: StatTone
}

const props = withDefaults(defineProps<StatProps>(), {
  value: null,
  unit: undefined,
  emptyText: '—',
  tone: 'default',
})

const attrs = useAttrs()
const forwarded = computed(() => {
  const rest = { ...attrs }
  delete rest.class
  return rest
})

const isEmpty = computed(
  () => props.value === null || props.value === undefined || props.value === '',
)

const toneClass = computed(
  () =>
    ({
      default: 'text-ink',
      accent: 'text-accent',
      'accent-alt': 'text-danger',
    })[props.tone],
)
</script>

<template>
  <StatPart v-bind="forwarded" :class="cn('flex flex-col', attrs.class as ClassValue)">
    <StatLabelPart class="text-[13px] font-medium text-ink-muted">{{ label }}</StatLabelPart>
    <StatValueRowPart class="mt-1 flex items-baseline gap-0">
      <StatValuePart
        :class="
          cn(
            'font-condensed text-[26px] leading-none font-medium tracking-[-0.01em] tabular-nums',
            'max-sm:text-[24px] lg:text-[28px]',
            isEmpty ? 'text-ink-faint' : toneClass,
          )
        "
      >
        {{ isEmpty ? emptyText : value }}
      </StatValuePart>
      <StatUnitPart
        v-if="unit && !isEmpty"
        class="ml-1.5 font-sans text-[14px] font-normal text-ink-muted lg:text-[16px]"
        >{{ unit }}</StatUnitPart
      >
      <StatFigurePart
        v-if="$slots.figure"
        class="min-w-0 flex-1 pl-3 font-condensed text-[26px] leading-none max-sm:text-[24px] lg:text-[28px]"
      >
        <slot name="figure" />
      </StatFigurePart>
    </StatValueRowPart>
  </StatPart>
</template>

import { definePrimitive } from '@ui-sdk/core'
import { createParts } from '@ui-sdk/vue/primitive'

const stat = definePrimitive({
  name: 'p0seid0n-stat',
  state: () => ({}),
  api: () => ({}),
  slots: (slot) => ({
    root: slot({}),
    label: slot({}),
    'value-row': slot({}),
    value: slot({}),
    unit: slot({}),
    figure: slot({}),
  }),
})

export const {
  Root: StatPart,
  Label: StatLabelPart,
  ValueRow: StatValueRowPart,
  Value: StatValuePart,
  Unit: StatUnitPart,
  Figure: StatFigurePart,
} = createParts(stat, {
  root: 'div',
  label: 'span',
  'value-row': 'div',
  value: 'span',
  unit: 'span',
  figure: 'span',
})

export { default as Stat } from './Stat.vue'
export type { StatProps, StatTone } from './Stat.vue'
